fact: The PS told the Public Accounts Committee Ardhisasa is rolled out in Nairobi, Murang'a, Mombasa Island and Isiolo, while the Auditor-General found only Nairobi and Murang'a fully migrated of Kenya's 83 land registries and digitisation is under way in Machakos, Kajiado and Baringo.
title: Why Ardhisasa expansion has fallen behind- PS Korir
